text:
Maria: Heads uprelease cutover at 19:00 PT. Need clear owners for version bump, concise changelog lines, SDK docs regen (all langs), and a docs staging smoke. Who can do SDK regen?
Ajay: I can take JS + Py regen. Which branch should I target?
Maria: Target release/v2.16 branch. Put artefacts under docs/sdk-*. Also add a one-line changelog bullet in Unreleased for each change.
Ajay: Okay. Will run regen in staging and push by 18:30 PT. Any snippet gotchas to watch for?
Lena: Note: codegen param rename landed in #4821 (callOpts -> callOptions). I'll prepare a short compat note and adjust examples post-regen. Tagging @Marc for smoke.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: docs staging deploy queued for 19:15 PT manual trigger required :alarm_clock:
Marc: I can do smoke. Please ping when PRs are ready so I can run /scripts/smoke-docs.sh staging.
Ajay: Regen complete  pushed docs/sdk-js-v2.16.1 and docs/sdk-py-v2.16.1 to release/v2.16. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/812
Maria: Thanks  I added changelog bullets for #5123 and #5150 in https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/813
Marc: Smoke started  failing snippet referencing old param name:
```
FAIL snippet-tests/snippet-js-generate.test.js
  expected param 'callOptions' but found 'callOpts'
```
Lena: I pushed a small snippet edit (PR 814) switching examples to callOptions and added a short note about the rename.
Marc: Re-ran smoke  all snippet tests passing now. Green across staging. Ready for prod canary when ops flips the switch.
Maria: We'll allow a 15 minute metrics ramp on staging before canary. Also reminder: run the console release notes generator after prod deploy to pull fresh titles. @Sara any copy tweaks?
Sara: Minor wording tweak to Dedicated section done inline in the docs PR  no other content changes. :thumbsup: 
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy to prod subset started at 19:45 PT  track logs in #deployments.
Ajay: I bumped example package versions in snippets to 2.16.1 to match the release. If we shift to a minor release number we need to update again.
Maria: Nicely coordinated. I'll cut the git tag and publish the release notes once canary metrics look stable. Will post tag + changelog here when complete. :tada:
